dataset: Korean Elementary Learning Map science subject workstream
subject: Science
sourceBasis: Official NCIC 2022 revised science curriculum PDF [별책9] was downloaded from the public NCIC inventory and parsed with pdftotext. Elementary achievement-standard codes, grade bands, unit headings, and broad science domains were checked against that extraction. Standard source bodies are not embedded.

textPolicy.summaryPolicy: Topic and standard summaries are source-derived paraphrases and decomposition labels; full official achievement-standard sentences are not reproduced.
textPolicy.licenseCaution: CLEARED: the cited Korean curriculum documents are state-published public materials openly available from their original sources (Ministry of Education, National Education Commission, NCIC). Preserve attribution and consult PROVENANCE.md.

sources.name: 교육부 고시 제2022-33호 [별책9] 과학과 교육과정.pdf
sources.usage: Governing source for elementary science unit structure, broad science domains, and achievement-standard code inventory.

notes: The previous v0.3 scaffold had 72 broad-domain science anchors; this subject artifact replaces that with 102 official elementary science achievement-standard codes from the 2022 PDF.
The official science PDF uses unit-style code families, 16 units for grades 3-4 and 16 units for grades 5-6, rather than the earlier five-domain scaffold.
Each official standard is decomposed into three candidate micro-topics: concept, representation/model/data, and procedure/application.
Dependency suggestions are intentionally candidates for the integration card, not reviewed prerequisite facts.
